facts.business: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Limited (GRSE) is a defence public sector undertaking under the Ministry of Defence, engaged in shipbuilding and engineering, delivering warships, patrol vessels, commercial vessels, deck machinery, marine diesel engines, and portable steel bridges.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Vision to steer towards Maharatna recognition by FY 2035
Establish greenfield shipyards at locations external to extant premises at Kolkata to fuel growth and overcome limitations to build/repair/recycle ships up to 400,000 DWT

key_risks: Significant estimates involved in determination of stage of completion and measurement of progress towards satisfaction of performance obligations in shipbuilding contracts
Change in estimation of cost to complete and expected sale consideration impacting financial results (projects P17A, ASWSWC & NGOPV)
Probable delivery time overrun leading to liquidated damages
